provenance.notes: Gap rule, safety-order side: DCA levels 99.02 / 98.02 / 97.02 (ATR 1, step 1 ATR), basket stop 95.02. Candle 282 opens at 97.6 (= its high: the first path point is the open), through two levels: both safety orders fill at the open, 97.6 x 1.0002 = 97.61952 (not at their levels), q = 0.612245 + 0.918367. avg 98.124884, basket target avg + 1 ATR = 99.124884, reached in candle 285 (high 99.125); exit at the target x 0.9998. The flat candles after 282 stay above the third level (low 97.05). The Windows probe's 0.212 R (engine) vs 0.167 R (backtest) was the replay's 8-step path, not a model gap: the engine booked the basket target at the step mark 99.375, 0.25 past the level. Shaped here so both legs end on the levels.
